name: UniFi Protect Doorbell
description: Live UniFi Protect doorbell video, listening and two-way audio. Includes guided setup and optional Home Assistant door-lock control. No restreamer required.
author: mark-andrew

buttons.title: Connect to Protect
buttons.label: Validate
buttons.description: Check the connection and find UniFi doorbells. Does not start video or the microphone.

settings.title: Console hostname or IP
settings.description: For example console.example.com or 192.168.1.1. Add :port if needed; HTTPS is automatic.

settings.title: Protect API key
settings.description: Create a separate key in UniFi Protect. Never share it in screenshots or bug reports.

settings.title: Connection status
settings.description: Updated by validation. Validate again after changing the connection.

settings.title: Doorbell
settings.description: Choose a doorbell, then Refresh the stream picker.

settings.title: Enabled stream
settings.description: Only existing enabled streams are listed. Quality never changes automatically.

settings.title: Image sizing
settings.description: Fit shows the whole picture; Fill crops to the screen; Stretch fills without preserving proportions.

settings.title: Viewport aspect
settings.description: Auto uses the full screen. Other values constrain the viewing area.

settings.title: Auto-close after inactivity
settings.description: Controls reset the timer. Talk suspends auto-close; a fresh timeout starts once transmission has stopped. Off keeps the viewer open.

settings.title: Enable two-way audio
settings.description: Tap the microphone to start/stop. Green is off; red is starting, live or stopping. Close, backgrounding, stream failure and microphone auto-off stop transmission.

settings.title: Microphone auto-off (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum Talk duration, including connection time.

settings.title: Door lock (optional)
settings.description: Green locked, red unlocked. Tap toggles without confirmation. Unknown/unavailable is hidden. Uses this kiosk's HA connection; blank disables.

settings.title: API certificate SHA-256 (optional)
settings.description: Managed by certificate acceptance. Blank uses Android TLS trust.

settings.title: Certificate approval console
settings.description: Managed by setup. Changing the console clears approval.
